ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Predominantly low-intensity (black/dark grey) core region comprising approximately 65-70% of the visible surface, with high-intensity (white/light grey) regions localized at the distal lobe extremities.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Central region is solid dark pigmentation. Left distal lobe features a white patch with 3-4 distinct dark circular spots. Right distal lobe features a larger white patch containing 5-6 dark circular spots and several dark linear pixel streaks.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep, acute V-shaped notch at the center-point with an estimated interior angle of 45-55 degrees and a high depth-to-width ratio.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Highly irregular trailing edge. Left lobe exhibits a major concave indentation approximately one-third inward from the tip. Both lobe tips display high-frequency, jagged serrations with visible encrustations.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: The leading edge exhibits a smooth convex curve, while the trailing edge follows an asymmetrical concave sweep towards the median notch.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Clustered dark circular spots on the white distal patches of both lobes. Several faint, circular white-ringed pixel formations are visible within the lower-central dark pigmentation area.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: A distinct horizontal dark line is present on the right lobe's white patch. Faint, parallel vertical line segments are detectable on the white patch of the left lobe.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Significant irregular notch/tissue loss on the trailing edge of the left lobe. Extensive high-relief textured clusters (likely barnacle colonization) present on the extreme tips of both lobes.
other_distinctive_markers: Symmetric circular 'ring' markings visible in the central-inferior dark zone of the fluke.
